description: Fork of exp740 (which had bf16 SDPA + bf16 unembedder and drifted +10 mb behind exp737 v2 by step 3200). Single change: remove the SDPA autocast wrap; keep only the self.unembedder(x_resid) autocast(bf16) wrap. SDPA returns to fp32 like exp737 v2. Isolates the cost of the bf16 unembedder alone vs exp737 v2 = 1.3872. If exp741 tracks exp737 v2 cleanly, bf16 SDPA was the source of exp740's drift; if exp741 also drifts, the bf16 unembedder is the culprit.
